text.aria-label: Title text 'Change in score from injecting shifts in more training stages, 8 folds (2025-11 to 2026-06) Score of the first arm minus the second, in points of capacity; below 0 is better for the first arm. Dot: estimate. Thick line: 98.33% bootstrap interval over months and seeds. Thin line: 98.33% t interval over months. Dashed line: no change. Eight seeds per arm; 16 Primaries; all rows.'
